title: UrjaDrishti — KREDL / KSPDCL Renewable Forecasting
summary: UrjaDrishti is an AI-enabled forecasting system for Karnataka solar and wind generation, combining LightGBM quantile models with conformal calibration to serve plant and cluster forecasts through a FastAPI backend and React dashboard. Its data pipeline uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit on seed data with a SingleTableMetadata object, to generate the synthetic multivariate time-series feature matrix used for model training.
